* Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is the total cost of borrowing provided as an annual percentage, which includes our current interest rate and charges such as appraisal costs and legal fees. If there are no charges applicable to a mortgage, such as on a transfer of your mortgage to Manulife Trust, then the APR will be as stated on this page, which is our current interest rate. If charges are included in your cost of borrowing as on a new home purchase then the APR will be slightly higher than stated. Interest is compounded semi-annually, not in advance.

* The Preferred Manulife One 5-year fixed term sub-account rate is 4.89% and is current as of October 2, 2026. ** The insurable Manulife Bank Select 5-year fixed term rate is 4.94% for loan to values up to 65% and is current as of October 2, 2026. The rate applies to new personal owner-occupied mortgages on primary residence with a value less than $1 million, who also meet additional insurability requirements. Interest is compounded semi-annually, not in advance. Subject to credit approval. Contact us for special offer terms and conditions. This is a discounted rate program. The posted 5-year rate is 5.39% and is current as of October 2, 2026. All rates are subject to change. Not eligible are: second position accounts; a roll-in from second to first position; a transfer from an existing Manulife Bank Select to a new property; an increase or change to an existing Manulife Bank Select account; a transfer from another existing Manulife Bank mortgage.

† The high-ratio Manulife Bank Select mortgage 5-year fixed term rate is 4.79% and is current as of October 2, 2026. The rate applies to new owner-occupied Manulife Bank Select High Ratio Purchase and Manulife Bank Insured Lender Switch mortgages up to $1 million, and is for new deals. Subject to credit approval. In the event that amounts deposited exceed $5 million, Manulife Bank may at any time adjust the interest rates applicable to the accounts.
